definitions.center_ce: L[4,4] on the 9x9 grid; CE in nats.
definitions.rim_rise: max(L[4+di,4+dj] for di,dj in {-1,0,1} except di=dj=0) - L[4,4]. The 8 immediate neighbors have coordinate spacing radius/4. No clipping at zero.
definitions.center_elevation: L[4,4] - mean(L[i,j] where i or j is 0 or 8). The perimeter contains 32 cells. No clipping at zero.
definitions.interpretation: Finite-grid diagnostics of these sampled slices; not global barriers, Hessian curvature or attack robustness. One seed and no replication; no p-values.
definitions.factor_coding: R/I/O are binary 0/1. R: retain 2.5/4; I: inner LR 1e-6/1e-5; O: outer LR 5e-6/1e-5.
definitions.anchored_coefficients: For subset S, c_S=sum(T subset S) (-1)^(|S|-|T|) f(1_T,0_else). No divisor. The exact 0/1 multilinear expansion is f(r,i,o)=c_empty+c_R*r+c_I*i+c_O*o+c_RI*r*i+c_RO*r*o+c_IO*i*o+c_RIO*r*i*o.
definitions.conditional_main: At each fixed combination of the other 2 factors, f(factor=1)-f(factor=0). No divisor; the marginal main contrast is the mean of 4 such differences, divisor 4.
definitions.conditional_pair: At each fixed setting of the third factor, f11-f10-f01+f00. No divisor; the marginal pair contrast is the mean of 2 such differences, divisor 2.
definitions.three_way: f111-f110-f101-f011+f100+f010+f001-f000. No divisor; also the difference between conditional pair contrasts at third-factor settings 1 and 0.

editorial_note: Text spacing clarified; prespecified numerical formulas unchanged. No new pair grids read.
